segments.normalizedSource: ```None let estimator = LinearTimeSeriesForecaster<Float>(configuration: configuration) var model = estimator.makeTransformer() let batches = try TimeSeriesForecasterBatches( features: features, // shape [N, featureSize] annotations: annotations, // shape [N, annotationSize] batchSize: 32, inputWindowSize: configuration.inputWindowSize, forecastWindowSize: configuration.forecastWindowSize, shufflesBatches: true ) for iteration in 0 ..< configuration.maximumIterationCount { for batch in batches { let loss = try await estimator.update(&model, with: batch) print("Loss: \(loss)") } } ```
